opinions.text:
Petition for writ of certiorari to the Supreme *661Court of Pennsylvania denied upon the ground that the federal question was not properly presented to, and was not passed upon by, the Supreme Court of Pennsylvania.

Messrs. Robert von Moschzisker, Schofield Andrews, and Nathan L. Miller for petitioners. Messrs. Wm. A. Schnader and William A. Gray for respondent.
